title: Unusual overnight API transfers
analyst_explanation: Two first-time payees received API instructions at 02:00, outside this customer's 90-day daytime baseline. AED 3,000 is held pending an independent customer decision.

customer_message.en: We paused two unusual overnight payments totaling AED 3,000. Were these yours?
customer_message.ar: أوقفنا مؤقتاً دفعتين غير معتادتين ليلاً بقيمة ٣٬٠٠٠ درهم. هل أجريتهما؟

title: AED 450,000 offshore wire blocked
analyst_explanation: An unfamiliar API client attempted a rapid offshore wire after two new-payee transfers at 02:00. The AED 450,000 instruction targets 86.55% of the current balance. Deterministic policy froze the consent token before posting; authentication success is not evidence of customer intent.

customer_message.en: We blocked an unusual AED 450,000 overseas payment at 2 AM from an unfamiliar connected service. Your money has not left. Was this you?
customer_message.ar: حظرنا دفعة خارجية غير معتادة بقيمة ٤٥٠٬٠٠٠ درهم الساعة الثانية صباحاً من خدمة متصلة غير مألوفة. لم تغادر أموالك الحساب. هل أجريت هذه العملية؟
